title: Garden Delivery
shareTitle: Garden Delivery — Balance Water for Sunny's Flowers
description: Help Sunny balance a bright bucket across garden stones, pour it onto a thirsty flower, and make the tiny clay garden bloom.
learningGoals: Practice steady, intentional movement with gentle tablet tilts or finger control
Notice and counter a visible gentle breeze while balancing
Build confidence through a forgiving carry-and-care loop with no fail state
interactionModel: Choose a flower, keep the bucket marker in the visible center of a touchable balance rail with a tablet tilt, one-finger slide, or arrow-key slider control, then tip toward the flower to pour.
feedbackModel: Sunny hops across stones, a playful splash invites recentering without lost progress, and each thirsty flower blooms with spoken celebration.

modes.title: Rose
modes.skill: Find and hold a wide, calm balance center.

modes.title: Tulip
modes.skill: Counter one slow visible breeze while staying level.
